content:
蘋果CEO Tim Cook喺X上發咗一條風趣嘅帖文，分享咗一段影片，顯示「精靈寶可夢」團隊到訪Apple Park，比卡超四處走動。即刻睇片。

Pikachu visits Apple Park

蘋果今日喺Apple Park接待「精靈寶可夢」團隊，期間佢哋趁機輕鬆一番。

In a video shared on X, Cook jokingly said that the day's agenda was to introduce the "Pokémon" team to incoming CEO John Ternus, "talk a little about games," and "politely ask Pikachu not to wander near the pond."

Cook仲話：「我哋做到三件事入面嘅兩件。」

The accompanying video shows Pikachu walking around Apple Park, stretching its little legs to pick up an apple from beneath an apple tree, and eventually heading toward the pond. Cook, Ternus, and The Pokémon Company CEO Tsunekazu Ishihara later join in.

Although neither Apple nor The Pokémon Company provided further details about the visit, the clip is entertaining enough to warrant your 30 seconds.

The meeting between the two CEOs comes just weeks after Sensor Tower reported that mobile game revenue declined 4.5% year-over-year in the second quarter of 2026.

The Apple and The Pokémon Company meeting comes just weeks after they acknowledged that weakening mobile game performance was beginning to weigh on App Store growth.

During the Q3 2026 earnings call, Apple CFO Kevan Parekh specifically cited "headwinds in mobile gaming" as one of the factors affecting App Store performance that quarter. Stay tuned for more updates.
